harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: «لعنة» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «ويوم القيامة»: the wāw is a conjunction; «يوم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the position of «هذه». «بئس الرفد المرفود»: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); «المرفود» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "it is المرفود". The clause «بئس الرفد» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position, and the clause «هو المرفود» is explicative of the clause of blame.

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من أنباء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ذلك», and the clause «نقصُّه» is the khabar (predicate). «حصيد» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted, i.e. «ومنها». The clause «منها قائم» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «نقصُّه», and the clause «ومنها حصيد» is conjoined to the clause «منها قائم».

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: The clause «ظلموا» is conjoined to the clause «وما ظلمناهم». The preposition and its genitive noun «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the referring pronoun. «شيء» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida), i.e. "any availing, little or much". The clause «لما جاء أمر ربك» is parenthetical. «غير تتبيب»: a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: «وكذلك»: the wāw is a conjunction; the kāf is a noun meaning "like", the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «أخْذ». The clause «وكذلك أخذ» is conjoined to the clause {وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ}. «إذا» is a pure ẓarf (adverb) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) (أَخْذ). The clause «وهي ظالمة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «القرى».

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «لمن خاف» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «لآية». «ذلك يوم»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); «مجموع» is a naʿt of «يوم», and the preposition and its genitive noun «له» is attached to «مجموع»; «الناس» is a nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause «وذلك يوم» is conjoined to the clause «ذلك يوم».

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «لأجل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نؤخِّره», and the clause «وما نؤخره» is conjoined to the single-word naʿt (adjective) {مَشْهُودٌ}.

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: «يوم» is a ẓarf (adverb) of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تَكَلَّمُ». «يأت» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ that is omitted in the script. The preposition and its genitive noun «بإذنه» is attached to «تكلَّم». «فمنهم شقي»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to the khabar (predicate); «شقي» is the mubtadaʾ (subject). «وسعيد»: a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "and of them is سعيد". The clause «لا تكلم نفس» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in {مَشْهُودٌ}, the pronoun being implied, i.e. «فيه». The clause «ومنهم سعيد» is conjoined to the clause «فمنهم شقي».

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: The clause «فأمَّا الذين شقوا» is conjoined to the clause {فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِيٌّ وَسَعِيدٌ}. «أما» is a particle of condition and detailing. «ففي النار»: the fāʾ falls in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين». The preposition and its genitive noun «لهم» is attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «زفير»; the preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» is attached to the notion of "being settled" (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached. The clause «لهم فيها زفير» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «النار».

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: «خالدين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in {لَهُمْ}. «ما» is a temporal maṣdar-forming particle; «ما دامت»: «دامت» is a complete past verb, and the interpreted maṣdar is accusative (manṣūb) as an adverb (ẓarf), attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خالدين», i.e. "for the duration of their remaining". [Translator's note: the quotation marks in the first part of this entry are misplaced in the source text; they are restored here according to the sense.] The clause «دامت» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative. «إلا» is a particle of exception; «ما» is a relative noun, the excepted. The meaning of the exception is the bringing out of the disobedient monotheists after a period of their stay in the Fire. «لما»: the lām is redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening; «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: «ففي الجنة»: the fāʾ is connective, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين». «خالدين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «سعدوا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» is attached to «خالدين». «عطاء»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); «غير» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: The clause «فلا تك» is resumptive. The imperfect verb is an abrogating verb (nāsikh), jussive (majzūm) with an implied (muqaddar) sukūn on the nūn omitted for lightening. The preposition and its genitive noun «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «مرية». «كما»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdar-forming, i.e. "except a worship like the worship of their fathers". «نصيبهم»: the object of «موفُّوهم»; «غير» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «نصيب».

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: The clause «فاختلف فيه» is conjoined to the clause «لقد آتينا», with no grammatical position. «كلمة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted; the clause «سبقت» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كلمة». The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قضي» is a pronoun referring to its maṣdar (verbal noun).

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: «لمَّا»: a jussive particle whose verb has been omitted, its implied form being: «لما يُوَفَّوا أعمالهم», i.e. up to now they have not been paid them in full, and they will be paid them in full. «ليوفينَّهم» points to it, and points to the full payment not having occurred and that it will occur; what is negated by «لما» is usually something whose coming about is expected. «أعمالهم» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «لما يُوَفُّوا» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the clause «ليوفينهم» is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:112-112.t: The clause «فاستقم كما أمرت» is resumptive. The kāf is a noun meaning "like", standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdar-forming, i.e. "be upright with an uprightness like the uprightness you were commanded"; the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «من» is a relative noun conjoined to the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «استقم».

harrat-mujtaba:113-113.t: «فتمسكم»: the fāʾ is causal, and the imperfect verb is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the fāʾ. The interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. "let there be no inclining, then a touching". The clause «وما لكم من دون الله من أولياء» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the kāf in «تمسكم». The preposition and its genitive noun «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «أولياء», the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition and its genitive noun «من دون» is attached to a ḥāl from «أولياء». The clause «لا تنصرون» is conjoined to the clause «وما لكم أولياء».

harrat-mujtaba:114-114.t: «طرفي»: a ẓarf (adverb) of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقم». The clause «ذلك ذكرى» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:116-116.t: (فلولا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The fāʾ is resumptive; «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); «كان» is a complete past verb. The preposition and its genitive noun «من القرون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كان»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من قبلكم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «القرون». «أولو» is the fāʿil (agent) of «كان». The preposition and its genitive noun «في الأرض» is attached to a ḥāl from «الفساد». «قليلا» is an excepted noun, accusative (manṣūb), and the preposition and its genitive noun «ممن» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «قليلا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «منهم» is attached to a ḥāl from «مَنْ». The clause «واتبع» is resumptive, and the clause «كانوا» is conjoined to the clause «اتبع»; «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:117-117.t: The lām in «ليهلك» is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «كان», implied as «مُريدًا». The clause «وأهلها مصلحون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «القرى».

harrat-mujtaba:118-118.t: The clause «ولا يزالون» is conjoined to an implied clause, i.e. "but He did not will". The implied clause is conjoined to the conditional clause.

harrat-mujtaba:119-119.t: «من» is a relative noun, accusative (manṣūb) as excepted. The clause «خلقهم» is resumptive, as is the clause «وتمَّت». The clause «والله لأملأن» is explicative of «الكلمة», and the clause «لأملأن» is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position. «أجمعين» is a tawkīd (emphasis), genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:120-120.t: «وكلا نقص»: the wāw is resumptive; «كُلا» is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «نقصّ», and the preposition and its genitive noun «عليك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the preposition and its genitive noun «من أنباء» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «كلا». The tanwīn in «كل» compensates for a muḍāf ilayhi, i.e. "every tiding". «ما» is a relative noun, badal (substitute) from «كلا». The clause «وجاءك» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الأنباء», and «الحق» is the fāʿil (agent) of «جاءك». The preposition and its genitive noun «للمؤمنين» is attached to a naʿt of «ذكرى».

harrat-mujtaba:121-121.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «على مكانتكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «اعملوا». The clause «إنا عاملون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «كتاب»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "this is a Book". The clause «أحكمت آياته» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كتاب». «لدن» is an adverbial noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive by the preposition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فُصِّلَتْ».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن لا تعبدوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. The two prepositional phrases «لكم» and «منه» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) «نذير».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن استغفروا» is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar, and «أن» is maṣdariyya. «يمتعكم»: jussive (majzūm), because it occurs in the apodosis of an implied condition. «متاعا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar). The preposition «إلى أجل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «يمتعكم». «يؤت» is made transitive to two objects: «كلَّ» and «فضلَه».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The clause «إلى الله مرجعكم» is resumptive, and the preposition «على كل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) «قدير».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «حين» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يعلم», and the clause «يستغشون» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The clause «يعلم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The wāw is resumptive; «ما» is negating and inoperative; «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida); «دابة» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «دابة». «إلا على الله رزقها»: «إلا» is for restriction, and the preposition is attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «رزقها»; the clause «رزقها على الله» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «دابة». The clause «يعلم» is conjoined to the clause «رزقها على الله». The clause «كل في كتاب» is resumptive, and the tanwīn in «كل» is in compensation for a single word, i.e. "everything".

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «وكان عرشه على الماء» is parenthetical between the verb and what is attached to it, and the wāw is parenthetical. «أيكم أحسن عملا»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «أحسن» is its khabar (predicate), and «عملا» is a tamyīz (specification). The clause is the second object of the verb «يبلوكم», which is made to include the meaning of a verb transitive to two objects. The clause «وهو الذي» is conjoined to the clause «وما من دابة إلا على الله رزقها». «ولئن قلت»: the wāw is resumptive, the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa), and the clause «ليقولن» is the answer to the oath. «إن هذا»: «إنْ» is negating, «هذا» is the mubtadaʾ, its khabar is «سحر», and «إلا» is for restriction.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: «ليقولُنَّ»: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; the verb is an imperfect verb, nominative by the presence of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, is the fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is for emphasis. «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يحبسه» is the khabar (predicate). «ألا يوم يأتيهم»: «ألا» is a particle of alerting and opening; «يوم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of «ليس», «مصروفًا»; its noun is the pronoun of the punishment; the preposition «عنهم» is attached to «مصروفا»; and the clause «ألا يوم يأتيهم ...» is resumptive. «ما كانوا»: a relative noun, the fāʿil of «حاق», and the preposition «به» is attached to «يستهزئون». [Translator's note: the quotation marks in this part of the source are misplaced; the words quoted are rendered here according to the evident sense.]

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: «رحمة» is the second object, and the preposition «منا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «رحمة». The clause «إنه ليئوس» is the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «بعد»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أذقناه». The clause «مسَّتْه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ضراء». The clause «ليقولن» is the answer to the oath, and the clause «إنه لفرح» is resumptive; «فخور» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «الذين» is the excepted, and the clause «لهم مغفرة» is the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «فلعلك تارك» is resumptive. «بعض» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «تارك», «ضائق» is conjoined to «تارك», and «صدرك» is the fāʿil (agent); the preposition «به» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ضائق». The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يقولوا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "out of dislike". «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). The clause «والله على كل شيء وكيل» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: «أم» is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, and the clause after it is resumptive. «فأتوا»: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are truthful, then bring". «مثله»: a naʿt (adjective) of «عشر», and «مفتريات» is a naʿt of «سور». The preposition «من دون الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مَنْ». The clause «إن كنتم صادقين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: «أنما» is a restraining particle with the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa), having no governing effect, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) made of «أنَّ» and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «علم». «وأن لا إله إلا هو»: the wāw is a conjunction; «أنْ» is lightened from the heavy form, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), its implied form being "and that it…"; «لا» is the lā of generic negation, and its noun is indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "deserving of worship"; «إلا» is for restriction; «هو» is a badal (substitute) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar; and the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar. The clause «لا إله إلا هو» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of «أن», and the clause «فهل أنتم مسلمون» is resumptive. [Translator's note: the quotation marks in this part of the source are misplaced; the words quoted are rendered here according to the evident sense.]

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «من» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «كان» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). «نُوَفِّ» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by dropping of the weak letter. The clause «وهم فيها لا يبخسون» is conjoined to the clause «نُوَفِّ», with no grammatical position, and the preposition «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يبخسون».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «أولئك الذين»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). «النار» is the noun of laysa; the two prepositional phrases «لهم في الآخرة» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of laysa; «إلا» is for restriction; and the clause «ليس لهم إلا النار» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause «وحبط» is conjoined to the ṣila. «وباطل ما كانوا»: the wāw is a conjunction, «باطل» is a khabar placed first, «ما» is a relative, mubtadaʾ, and the clause «وباطل ما كانوا يعملون» is conjoined to the clause «حبط», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The hamza is for interrogation and the fāʾ is a conjunction. «من» is a relative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "like someone else". The preposition «على بينة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of kāna, and the preposition «من ربه» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «بينة». The clause "is the one who is … like someone else?" is conjoined to the clause «أولئك الذين» in the preceding verse. The clause «ويتلوه شاهد» is conjoined to the clause «كان على بينة». The preposition «ومن قبله» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «كتاب», and «كتاب» is conjoined to «شاهد», i.e. the Torah and the Gospel follow Muḥammad in confirmation; the conjunction and the conjoined are separated by the prepositional phrase, the implied form being: "a witness from Him, and the Book of Moses before it", and this separation does no harm. «إمامًا»: a ḥāl from «كتاب». The clause «أولئك يؤمنون به» is resumptive, and the clause «ومن يكفر» is conjoined to the clause «أولئك يؤمنون به». The clause «فلا تك» is resumptive; the defective (nāqiṣ) verb is jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and the sign of its jussive is a sukūn implied on the nūn, which was dropped for lightening. The preposition «منه» is attached to a naʿt of «مرية», and the preposition «من ربك» is attached to a ḥāl from «الحق». The clause «ولكن أكثر الناس لا يؤمنون» is conjoined to the clause «إنه الحق».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «ومن أظلم» is resumptive; «من» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أظلم» is its khabar (predicate); the preposition «ممن افترى» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أظلم». The clause «أولئك يعرضون» is resumptive, and the clause «ويقول الأشهاد» is conjoined to the clause «أولئك يعرضون», with no grammatical position; the linking element is implied, i.e. "about them". The clause «ألا لعنة ...» is resumptive, and «ألا» is a particle of opening and alerting.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الظالمين» in the verse before it. The clause «وهم كافرون» is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position, and the second «هم» is a verbal tawkīd (emphasis) of the first.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) «معجزين». «وما كان لهم»: the wāw is a conjunction, «ما» is negating and inoperative, «كان» is abrogating, the preposition «لهم» is attached to the khabar, the preposition «من دون» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أولياء», «أولياء» is the noun of «كان», and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause is conjoined to the clause «لم يكونوا», in the position of the nominative. The clause «يضاعف لهم العذاب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and likewise the clause «ما كانوا يستطيعون السمع».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «ما كانوا»: a relative noun, fāʿil (agent). The clause «وضلَّ» is conjoined to the clause «خسروا».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «لا جرم»: «لا» is the lā of generic negation, with its noun, and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "existing". The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is accusative by removal of the preposition (في). The preposition «في الآخرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «الأخسرون», and the clause «هم الأخسرون» is the khabar of «أن».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «أولئك أصحاب» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», in the position of the nominative, and the clause «هم فيها خالدون» is a second khabar of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «هل يستويان» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «أفلا تذكرون». «مثلا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «ولقد أرسلنا نوحًا» is resumptive, and the clause «لقد أرسلنا» is the answer to an implied oath. «نذير مبين» are two khabars (predicates) of «إن». The clause «إني نذير» is the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied verb of saying, a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «نوحًا», i.e. "saying".

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: «أن» is explicative, and the clause «لا تعبدوا» is explicative of the warner. The clause «إني أخاف» is resumptive within the scope of the preceding saying.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الملأ», and the preposition «من قومه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw of «كفروا». The clause «ما نراك» is the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl); «إلا» is for restriction; «بشرًا» is a ḥāl; «مثلنا» is a naʿt of «بشرًا»; «الذين» is the fāʿil (agent) of «اتبعك»; and the clause «اتبعك» is a ḥāl from the kāf in «نراك». «بادي»: an adverb of time, i.e. "at the time of the first occurrence of their matter", attached to «اتبعك». «وما نرى لكم علينا من فضل»: the preposition «لكم» is attached to «نرى», the preposition «علينا» is attached to a ḥāl from «فضل», «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida), and «فضل» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «نظنكم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: «يا قوم»: the one addressed (munādā), in construct, accusative with a fatḥa implied on the letter before the dropped yāʾ. The first object of «أرأيتم» is omitted, its implied form being "the clear proof". The preposition «من ربي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بينة». The clause «وآتاني رحمة» is parenthetical, and the yāʾ and «رحمة» are the two objects of «آتاني». The clause «إن كنت على بينة» is parenthetical between the verb and its second object. The clause «وآتاني رحمة» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items «كنت» and «عُمِّيت». The clause «أنلزمكموها» is the second object of «أرأيتم». «أنلزمكموها»: an imperfect verb; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the mīm is for the plural, the wāw is for lengthening (ishbāʿ), and the pronoun hāʾ is the second object; the second-person pronoun was placed before the third-person one because it is more specific. The clause «وأنتم لها كارهون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun kāf in the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: «مالا» is the second object. «إن أجري»: «إن» is negating, and a mubtadaʾ (subject); «إلا» is for restriction, and the preposition «على الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «إن أجري» is resumptive within the scope of the answer to the vocative. The bāʾ in the khabar of «ما» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «إنهم ملاقو» is resumptive within the scope of the answer to the vocative, and the clause «ولكني أراكم» is conjoined to the clause «ما أنا بطارد». [Translator's note: the quotation marks in this part of the source are misplaced; the words quoted are rendered here according to the evident sense.]

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: «من» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «ينصرني» is the khabar (predicate). The clause «إن طردتهم» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «أفلا تذكرون».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «خزائن» is a mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «ولا أعلم» is conjoined to the clause «لا أقول». The clause «الله أعلم» is resumptive within the scope of the answer to the vocative. The particle «إذًا» conveys an answer.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The clause «فأتنا» is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are truthful, then bring us".

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: «إنما يأتيكم به الله»: a restraining particle with the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa), having no governing effect, and the word of majesty is the fāʿil (agent). The clause «إن شاء» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «وما أنتم بمعجزين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the kāf in «يأتيكم», and the bāʾ in «بمعجزين» is redundant (zāʾida), in the khabar (predicate) of «ما», which operates like laysa.

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: «نصحي» is the fāʿil (agent) of «ينفع». The clause «إن أردت» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «إن كان الله» is resumptive, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by the first condition and its apodosis, i.e. "if Allah wills to lead you astray, then if I wish to advise you, my advice will not benefit you". The clause «هو ربكم» is resumptive, and the clause «وإليه ترجعون» is conjoined to the clause «هو ربكم».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: «أم» is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, and the clause after it is resumptive. «ما» in «ممَّا تجرمون» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive by «مِنْ», attached to (mutaʿalliq) «بريء». The clause «وأنا بريء» is conjoined to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), in the position of the jussive.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أنه لن يؤمن» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «من» is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent); and «إلا» is for restriction. The clause «فلا تبتئس» is conjoined to the clause «لن يؤمن». The clause «يفعلون» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of kāna.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The preposition «بأعيننا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «اصنع», and the clause «إنهم مغرقون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: The clause «ويصنع» is resumptive. «وكلما مر عليه ملأ»: the wāw is circumstantial; «كل» is an adverb of time; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct), i.e. "every time of passing". The clause «سخروا» is circumstantial, and the clause «مر» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative, with no grammatical position. The preposition «من قومه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ملأ». «كما تسخرون»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e. "we mock with a mockery like your mockery".

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The clause «فسوف تعلمون» is conjoined to the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative. «مَن» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «يخزيه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «عذاب».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya). «وأهلك»: conjoined to «زوجين». «إلا» is for exception, and «مَن» is a relative, the excepted. The clause «وما آمن ...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The verb «اركبوا» was made to include the meaning of "alight/enter", so it was made transitive in the way that verb is. The preposition «بسم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and «مجراها» is the mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «بسم الله مجراها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «فيها».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «وهي تجري» is resumptive. The preposition «بهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent fāʿil (agent), and the second prepositional phrase is attached to a second ḥāl from the fāʿil of «تجري». The preposition «كالجبال» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «موج». The clause «ونادى نوح» is conjoined to the clause «وهي تجري», with no grammatical position, and the clause «وكان في معزل» is a ḥāl from «ابنه». «يا بني»: the one addressed (munādā), in construct, accusative with a fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person. Its original form is «بُنَيْوٌ»: yāʾ and wāw came together, the first of them came first with sukūn, so the wāw was changed into yāʾ and the yāʾ was assimilated into the yāʾ, giving «بُنَيّ». Then the yāʾ of the first person was added, so three yāʾs met; the second, the final radical (lām) of the word, was dropped, and the vowelless diminutive yāʾ remained and was assimilated with the yāʾ of the first person, which was added with fatḥa.

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «يعصمني» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جبل». «لا عاصم»: «لا» is the lā of generic negation, and «عاصم» is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. «اليوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أمر الله». The preposition «من أمر» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of (لا). «إلا» is a particle of exception, and «مَن» is accusative by connected exception (istithnāʾ muttaṣil). The clause «وحال بينهما الموج» is conjoined to the second clause «قال», and the clause «فكان» is conjoined to the clause «حالَ», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: «أقلعي»: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the yāʾ is the fāʿil (agent). The clause «يا سماء» is conjoined to «يا أرض», and the clause «وغيض الماء» is conjoined to the clause «قيل», with no grammatical position. «بعدا»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted governing word; the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بعدًا», and the clause «بعدا» is the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: «ربِّ»: the one addressed (munādā), in construct, accusative with a fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, which was dropped for lightening. The clause «وإن وعدك الحق» is conjoined to the answer to the vocative, and the clause «وأنت أحكم» is conjoined to the clause «إن وعدك الحق».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The clause «إنه عمل غير صالح» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the clause «فلا تسألني» is resumptive within the scope of the answer to the vocative; the vocative clause with its answer is the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl). The verb is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with sukūn; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ, implied in the script, is the object of the verb. «ما» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «ليس لك به علم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the preposition «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «ليس», and the preposition «به» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «علم».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن أسألك»: accusative by removal of the preposition (من). The relative «ما» is the second object. The clause «ليس لي به علم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the preposition «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the preposition «به» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «عِلم».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is the pronoun "it", referring to its maṣdar (verbal noun). The preposition «بسلام» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «اهبط», i.e. "accompanied". The preposition «منا» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «سلام». «وأمم سنمتعهم»: a mubtadaʾ (subject); what permits beginning with an indefinite noun is the implied qualification, i.e. "and nations of them, of those with you". The clause «سنمتعهم» is the khabar (predicate) of «أمم». The preposition «منا» is attached to a ḥāl from «عذاب».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من أنباء» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «نوحيها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أنباء», and the clause «ما كنت تعلمها» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the pronoun hāʾ in «نوحيها». The clause «فاصبر» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «إن العاقبة للمتقين».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: «وإلى عاد»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied «أرسلنا» ("We sent"); «أخاهم» is the object of this implied verb, accusative with alif; «هودا» is a badal (substitute). The implied clause «أرسلنا» is conjoined to «أرسلنا» in verse (25). «ما لكم من إله غيره»: «ما» is negating and inoperative; the preposition «لكم» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «إله»; «من» is redundant (zāʾida); «غيره» is a naʿt (adjective) of «إله» according to its position. The clause «ما لكم من إله غيره» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the word of majesty (Allah). The clause «إن أنتم إلا مفترون» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; «إن» is negating, «أنتم» is the mubtadaʾ, its khabar is «مفترون», and «إلا» is for restriction.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: «أجرا» is the second object, and the preposition «عليه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أجرا». «إن» is negating, and a mubtadaʾ (subject); «إلا» is a particle of restriction, and the preposition is attached to the khabar (predicate). The clause «إن أجري إلا على الذي» is resumptive within the scope of the answer to the vocative. The clause «أفلا تعقلون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: «يرسل»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you repent, He will send". «مدرارا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «السماء». «قوة» is the second object of «يزدكم», and the preposition «إلى قوتكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «قوة». «مجرمين» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «تتولوا».

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: «وما نحن بتاركي»: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is negating and operates like laysa; «نحن» is its noun; and the bāʾ in the khabar (predicate) is redundant (zāʾida). The preposition «عن قولك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «تاركي», i.e. "being and proceeding from your saying". The clause «وما نحن لك بمؤمنين» is conjoined to the clause «ما نحن بتاركي».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: «إن» is negating, and «إلا» is for restriction. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أني بريء» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. «ما» in «مما تشركون» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «بريء».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The preposition «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of the implied object of «تشركون», i.e. "you associate gods, being other than Him". The clause «فكيدوني» is resumptive. «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «كيدوني», and the yāʾ, dropped in the script, is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: «ربي» is a badal (substitute), genitive. «ما من دابة»: «ما» is negating, «دابة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); beginning with an indefinite noun is permissible because it is preceded by a negation. «إلا» is for restriction. «هو آخذ» is mubtadaʾ and khabar (predicate), and the preposition «بناصيتها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar. The clause «ما من دابة إلا هو آخذ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ربي», and the clause «هو آخذ» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «دابة».

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: «تولوا»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); its original form is «تتولوا», jussive by dropping of the nūn. «ما» is a relative, the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «غيركم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوما». The clause «ويستخلف» is resumptive. «شيئا»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "any harm, little or much".

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: The wāw is resumptive. «لما» is a particle of "occurrence upon occurrence" (wujūb li-wujūb), and the clause «نجينا» is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. «الذين» is a relative noun conjoined to «هودا». The adverb «معه» is an adverb of place for accompaniment, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آمنوا». The preposition «برحمة» is attached to «نجينا», and the preposition «منّا» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة».

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «جحدوا» is a second khabar (predicate). «عنيد» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جبار», genitive.

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: «لعنة» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «يوم القيامة»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «يوم» is an adverb of time conjoined to the position of «هذه», whose position is accusative. «ربهم» is a mafʿūl bihi; «كفر» includes the meaning of "deny" (جحد). «ألا» is a particle of opening and alerting. «بعدا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied governing word, and the preposition «لعادٍ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بعدًا»; «قوم» is a badal (substitute). The clause «ألا إن عادا كفروا» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «ألا بعدًا».

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: «وإلى ثمود»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied «أرسلنا» ("We sent"); «أخاهم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the implied verb, and «صالحا» is a badal (substitute). The implied clause «أرسلنا» is conjoined to the clause «أرسلنا» in verse (50). The clause «ما لكم من إله غيره» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the word of majesty (Allah); «ما» is negating; the preposition «لكم» is attached to the khabar (predicate); «إله» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); «غيره» is a naʿt (adjective) according to the nominative position of «إله», and it did not gain definiteness from the construct because it is extremely vague. The clause «هو أنشأكم» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the clause «فاستغفروه» is conjoined to the clause «استعمركم».

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The preposition «فينا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مرجوًّا», and likewise the adverb «قبل». The clause «أتنهانا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن نعبد» is accusative by removal of the preposition «عن». The clause «وإننا لفي شك» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «تنهانا», in the position of the accusative. The preposition «مما تدعونا» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «شك».

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: «أرأيتم» is transitive to two objects: the first is omitted, its implied form being "the clear proof", and the second object is likewise omitted, its implied form being "shall I disobey Him?", indicated by «إن عصيته». The clause «إن كنت» is parenthetical, interposed between the verb «أرأيتم» and its second object; the implied form is: "Have you considered the clear proof, if I am upon it — shall I disobey Him?". The clause «وآتاني منه رحمة» is conjoined to the parenthetical clause. The clause «فمن ينصرني» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The preposition «منه رحمة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «رحمة», and the two objects of «آتاني» are the yāʾ and «رحمة». «فما تزيدونني»: the fāʾ is resumptive, «غير» is the second object, and «تخسير» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The technical implied form (al-taqdīr al-ṣināʿī) of the verse is: "He said: O my people, have you considered the clear proof, if I am upon it and He has given me mercy from Him — shall I disobey Him? If I disobey Allah, who will help me?".

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آية», and «آية» is a ḥāl from «ناقة». The fāʾ in «فذروها» is a conjunction, and the clause «فذروها» is conjoined to the clause «هذه ناقة الله». «تأكل»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), because it occurs in the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you leave her, she will eat". The fāʾ in «فيأخذكم» is causative (sababiyya), and the verb is an imperfect verb, accusative by an obligatorily concealed «أن» after the fāʾ; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. "let there be no touching of her by you, and so a seizing of you with punishment".

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: «ثلاثة» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تمتعوا». «غير» is a naʿt (adjective). The clause «ذلك وعد» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: «برحمة منا»: the first prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نجينا», and the second prepositional phrase is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة». The preposition «من خزي» is attached to an implied element, i.e. "We saved them from disgrace". «يوم» is muḍāf, and «إذ» is an adverbial noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct); the tanwīn is in compensation for an omitted clause. «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). The implied clause "We saved them" is conjoined to the mentioned clause «نجينا», with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source's punctuation here reads «يوم» مضاف، إليه «إذ»; it is rendered according to the evident sense.]

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The clause «وأخذ» is conjoined to the preceding implied "We saved them". «الصيحة» is a fāʿil (agent) placed after. The preposition «في ديارهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and «جاثمين» is the khabar of the defective (nāqiṣ) «أصبح».

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: «كأن» is a lightened abrogating particle, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). The clause «كأن لم يغنوا» is a second khabar (predicate) of «أصبحوا», and the clause «لم يغنوا» is the khabar of «كأن». The clause «ألا إن ثمود كفروا» is resumptive. «بُعْدًا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governing word is implied, and the preposition «لثمود» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of (بعدًا). The clause «ألا بعدا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: The preposition «بالبشرى» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جاءت». The clause «قالوا» is resumptive. «سلاما» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "we greet with a greeting". «سلام» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "my answer is peace". The clause «فما لبث أن جاء» is resumptive. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن جاء» is accusative by removal of the preposition, and the meaning is: "he did not delay in his coming". The clause «جاء» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative.

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The clause «فلما رأى» is conjoined to the clause «فما لبث», with no grammatical position. The clause «لا تصل» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أيديهم». The clause «نكرهم» is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. «خيفة» is the object of «أوجس». The clause «إنا أرسلنا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The clause «وامرأته قائمة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of {قَالُوا}, and the clause «فضحكت» is conjoined to the clause «امرأته قائمة». «ومن وراء إسحاق يعقوب»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from «يعقوب»; «إسحاق» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct); «يعقوب» is a genitive noun conjoined to «إسحاق», so she was given the glad tidings of both. Separating the conjunction from the conjoined by a prepositional phrase is permissible.

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: «يا ويلتى»: the one addressed (munādā), in construct, accusative with a fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, which has been changed into an alif; this alif is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The clause «وأنا عجوز» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «ألد». The wāw in «وهذا بعلي شيخا» is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the clause «أنا عجوز». «شيخا»: a ḥāl from «بعلي».

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: «أهل»: accusative by an omitted verb, its implied form being "I praise", and its clause is resumptive. The clause «رحمت الله وبركاته عليكم» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the clause «إنه حميد مجيد» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; «مجيد» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The clause «وجاءته البشرى» is conjoined to the resumptive one, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "he became bold towards them". The clause «يجادلنا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «إبراهيم», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: «إنه»: the hāʾ is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), the noun of «إن». «وإنهم آتيهم»: the noun of «إن» and its khabar (predicate); «عذاب» is the fāʿil (agent) of «آتيهم», and «غير» is a naʿt (adjective). The clause is conjoined to the clause «إنه قد جاء أمر ربك».

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: «سيء»: a past verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is the pronoun of Lūṭ. «ذرعا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The clause «يُهرعون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «قومه». The wāw in «ومن قبل» is circumstantial, and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يعملون»; the clause «كانوا» is a ḥāl from «قومه». The clause «هن أطهر» is a ḥāl from «بناتي». «ولا تخزون»: «لا» is prohibitive, and the verb is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by dropping of the nūn; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition is attached to the verb. «رجل» is the noun of «ليس», and the preposition «منكم» is attached to the khabar (predicate). The clause «فاتقوا الله» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: «حق» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The preposition «لنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the preposition «في بناتك» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «حق». The clause «ما لنا حق» is the object of «علم», and the verb is suspended (muʿallaq) by the negating «ما».

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن لي بكم قوة»: the fāʿil (agent) of an implied «ثبت» ("it were established"). The preposition «بكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «قوة». The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "I would have dealt with you". The clause «أو آوي» is conjoined to the implied clause "it were established".

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The clause «لن يصلوا» is resumptive within the scope of the answer to the vocative, and the clause «فأسر» is conjoined to the clause «لن يصلوا». The preposition «بأهلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the bāʾ is for transitivity. The preposition «بقطع» is attached to the verb, and the bāʾ has the meaning of "in". The preposition «من الليل» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «قطع». «امرأتك»: the excepted. The preposition «منكم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أحد». «إنه مصيبها ما أصابهم»: «إن» is an abrogating particle, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), the hāʾ; «مصيبها» is a khabar (predicate) placed before the mubtadaʾ (subject), the relative «ما». The clause «إنه مصيبها ما أصابهم» is a ḥāl from «امرأتك», and the clause «مصيبها ما أصابهم» is the khabar of «إن», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: «جعل» means "made into" (صيَّر), and it is transitive to two objects: «عاليها سافلها». The preposition «من سجيل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «حجارة», and «منضود» is a naʿt of «سجيل».

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: «مسومة» is a naʿt (adjective) of {حِجَارَةً}. «عند»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مسومة». The clause «وما هي من الظالمين ببعيد» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the qualified {حِجَارَةً}. The bāʾ in the khabar (predicate) of «ما» is redundant (zāʾida), and the preposition «من الظالمين» is attached to «بعيد». The masculine form of «بعيد» is permissible because it is originally a naʿt of an omitted thing, i.e. "and it is not a far-off thing".

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: «وإلى مدين»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied «أرسلنا» ("We sent"); «أخاهم»: the object of the implied verb, and «شعيبا» is a badal (substitute). The implied clause «وأرسلنا» is conjoined to the implied «أرسلنا» in verse (50). «ما لكم من إله غيره»: «ما» is negating and inoperative; the preposition is attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «إله»; «من» is redundant (zāʾida); «غيره»: a naʿt (adjective) according to the nominative position of «إله»; and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the word of majesty (Allah). The preposition «بخير» is attached to a ḥāl from the kāf.

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: The preposition «بالقسط» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «أوفوا». «بخس» is transitive to two objects: «الناس» and «أشياءهم». «مفسدين» is a ḥāl from the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: The clause «إن كنتم» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «وما أنا بحفيظ» is conjoined to the clause «بقيت الله خير», with no grammatical position, and the bāʾ in the khabar (predicate) of «ما» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن نترك» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. The second maṣdar is conjoined to «ما», so it is governed by the "leaving"; the meaning is: "that we leave doing…". The lām in «لأنت» is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). The clause «أنت الحليم» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and «الرشيد» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: «أرأيتم» is transitive to two objects; the first is omitted, its implied form being "the clear proof". The preposition «من ربي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بينة». «رزقا»: the second object. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن أخالفكم»: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the preposition «إلى ما أنهاكم» is attached to «أخالف». The clause «إن كنت» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it; it is interposed between the omitted first object, whose implied form is "the clear proof", and the omitted second object, whose implied form is "shall I contravene His command?". The clause «إن أريد إلا الإصلاح» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; «إنْ» is negating, and «إلا» is for restriction. «ما استطعت»: «ما» is maṣdariyya and temporal, and the interpreted maṣdar is accusative as an adverb, i.e. "for the duration of my ability", attached to «أريد». The clause «وما توفيقي إلا بالله» is conjoined to the clause «أريد», with no grammatical position. The clause «عليه توكلت» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: «لا يجرمنَّكم شقاقي»: «لا» is prohibitive, and the verb is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the nūn of emphasis, and the nūn has no grammatical position; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «شقاقي» is the fāʿil (agent). The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يصيبكم» is the second mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "let not my enmity earn you being struck by the punishment"; the clause «يصيبكم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative. The clause «وما قوم لوط ببعيد» is resumptive; the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and «ما» operates like laysa.

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: «كثيرا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كثيرا». «ضعيفا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the kāf. «ولولا رهطك»: the wāw is a conjunction; «لولا» is a particle of non-occurrence due to existence (imtināʿ li-wujūd); and a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "existing". The clause «ولولا رهطك» is conjoined to the answer to the vocative, with no grammatical position. The clause «وما أنت علينا بعزيز» is conjoined to the answer to the vocative, and the bāʾ in the khabar of «ما» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: The preposition «عليكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) «أعز», and likewise «من الله». «واتخذتموه»: the wāw is circumstantial; it is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn; the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), the mīm is for the plural, and the wāw is for lengthening (ishbāʿ); the hāʾ and «ظهريا» are the two objects of «اتخذ». The clause «واتخذتموه» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the word of majesty (Allah), in the position of the accusative. «ما» in «بما تعملون» is maṣdariyya, and the preposition "with your deeds" (بعملكم) is attached to the khabar «محيط».

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: The preposition «على مكانتكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «اعملوا». The clause «إني عامل» is resumptive, and the clause «سوف تعلمون» is resumptive within the scope of the answer to the vocative. «من يأتيه»: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «وارتقبوا» is conjoined to the clause «تعلمون». «رقيب»: a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: «ولما»: the wāw is resumptive, and a particle of "occurrence upon occurrence" (wujūb li-wujūb). The preposition «منا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة». The preposition «في ديارهم» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of «أصبح», «جاثمين». The clause «فأصبحوا» is conjoined to the clause «أخذت».

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: «كأن لم يغنوا»: a lightened abrogating particle, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). The clause «كأن لم يغنوا» is a second khabar (predicate) of the verb «أصبحوا», in the position of the accusative, and the clause «لم يغنوا» is the khabar of «كأن», in the position of the nominative. «بعدًا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and its clause is resumptive. The preposition «لمدين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بُعدًا». The kāf in «كما» is a noun meaning "like", an adjective of «بعدا»; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: The preposition «إلى فرعون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the preceding {أَرْسَلْنَا}. The clause «وما أمر فرعون برشيد» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the preceding «أمر فرعون», and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) of «ما», which operates like laysa.

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: The clause «يقدم» is resumptive, and the clause «فأوردهم» is conjoined to the resumptive one. «وبئس الورد المورود»: the wāw is resumptive; a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); «المورود» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "it". The implied form of the speech is: "evil is the place of watering — it is the one watered at", i.e. the Fire. The clause is circumstantial, and the clause "it is the one watered at" is explicative of the clause of blame.
